facts.fact: Max 夜里溜回学员营房，身上还带着 Nikolai 的气味
facts.quote: I slipped into the barracks, Nikolai’s scent still on my skin.

facts.fact: Bryn 从自己的上铺跳下，落地不绊、几步冲过房间，像小货车一样撞进 Max 怀里抱住她
facts.quote: She hit me like a small freight vehicle, arms around my ribs, squeezing hard.

facts.fact: Max 拒绝把营外发生的事全告诉 Bryn，称那是机密
facts.quote: “Classified, Bryn.” I held her gaze. “I’m serious. Some of what happened out there? I can’t talk about it.”

facts.fact: Max 只向 Bryn 透露列车袭击是恶魔所为、恶魔来自 DarkVeil
facts.quote: “True.” I chose my words carefully. “It was a demon attack. They came out of the DarkVeil. That’s all I can say.”

facts.fact: Delia 带着一个褐发女孩、一个粉发女孩和另外两人走向 Max 的铺位发难
facts.quote: Delia led her circle toward my bunk, a brunette, a pink-haired girl, and two others, probably from the magical class.

facts.fact: Max 反击 Delia，叫她不如去问自己的男朋友
facts.quote: “Why don’t you go ask your boyfriend?” I said sweetly.

facts.fact: 学员中士 Thane 在门外喝令熄灯，并威胁再出声就半夜跑圈
facts.quote: “Lights out! One more sound and you’re running laps at midnight.”

facts.fact: Max 躺下后想起 Missy 此刻正被 Collector 关着，照旧哼出那两声上下的信号等她回应，并在心里宣告要去救她
facts.quote: She’d be making the sound now, wherever the Collector kept her. Two notes, up and down. Waiting for me to give it back.

relations: Max 与 Bryn 是同铺室友兼挚友，Bryn 曾以为 Max 死在营外
Max 与 Nikolai（吸血鬼王子）有血之契约，行踪与气味仍留在她身上
Max 随四位继承人 Nikolai、Aelindor、Caspian、Drakken 出任务
Delia 是 Caspian 的女友，Max 以“去问你男朋友”回击她
Delia 的圈子由褐发女孩 Petra、粉发女学员等数人组成
学员中士 Thane 管辖整个一阶学员营房（含女生层）
Missy 是 Max 的妹妹，被 Collector 关押，Max 承诺一个月内回来救她
Drakken 与 Max 相处别扭，却替她拿来了睡铺并留下
numbers: a decade in the underground mine
crossed the room in four strides
less than a month or two
A month, I’d promised, the day I went over the fence. Two at most, and I’ll come back for you.
